discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology moved from basic hormone discovery to drugs that changed diabetes and obesity treatment and now show cardiovascular and kidney benefits. The work has won the Lasker, Breakthrough and Gairdner awards, and Habener, Mojsov and Knudsen are the trio named most often.
